task: AutoLabel common 60-second windows with signed original group roles, same three seeds and raw official window labels

methods.LightGBM: Original ExtraTrees current-event features, samples and supervision; independent LightGBM with validated leaves; top three event scores per window.
methods.NLLog: Detection-path adaptation. AutoLabel has syscalls in place of application-alert signatures; render them as typed descriptions, pooled with fold-specific training-only IDF using the same frozen MiniLM, followed by the prior LightGBM settings and train-only CV.
methods.DeepCASE: Official causal within-source endpoint context of ten prior typed observations per exercise (up to 24 h), coarsened to at most 24 deterministic, syscall-stratified query events per window, full observation stream supplies their context; official 10 epochs and 100 query iterations, window pooled readout and original LightGBM head.
methods.UnseenLog: Window-level bidirectional syscall transition graph with counts/intervals; upstream Transformer, augmenters and MinMax, 40 initial epochs, 3 RISE rounds and validation F1 selection, independent role vocabulary.
methods.Velox: Existing clean-prefix CVE results and exact roster-equivalent folds; the two application-only rosters retrain using the signed eight-epoch pipeline. Top 3 incident mapped event losses. Original ET/AUGUR reused unchanged.

selection: Same 20 exercises per source scene; label of raw window is any case-positive event. Fit and choose candidates with train and validation only. Score every common test window and preserve empty-projection windows. For graph/context methods the sample is the window. Same metric and labels across methods, supervision differs.
notes: Internal cross-group benchmark, explicitly task-adapted; loop over both protocols; no broad external validity claim.
